Act I · UI Design

Links to the living site

the decree

The title box links to other namespaces in the plugin. it should link to resources in www.shanaghy.com/profiles or other entities.

Round 22 struck the kin pills' namespace jumps: each became a plain <a target="_blank"> opening its entity's profile page on the living site. Fenrir's kin became Gleipnir and Loki; the truth-finder's, Fionn and the Salmon of Knowledge; the mower's, the Mossiah himself and the ancestral bog. Every world's kin now walks out of the throne and into the garden's own pages.

Act II · Data

Crawl the whole realm

the decree

Ensure the title of the box links to it's own profile on shanaghy.com and any referenced entities in the descriptions. crawl the site now to scrape the info a link it together and build our little internal knowledge db in json directly embedd in the plugin and website

The living site was walked page by page — 98 pages — and scraped into realm-knowledge.json: 36 entity profiles with their kin and memories, 33 projects, 14 laws, 9 ballad beds, 8 halls, every persona link followed and knotted back into a mentions graph. The db embeds verbatim in the prototype as the REALM const; the world's NAME now opens its own page — Fenrir's chronicles bed, the throne stone, the mower stone, the say-so hall card — and the lore's entity mentions are linkified: names and aliases, longest first, first telling only.

The Mend

Two mends in the telling: a name-link read its db before the lookup was sworn (a TDZ throw that half-drew the title), and linkify's alternation forgot its joining rune — a missing .join("|") meant no mention ever matched.

Act III · Interaction

The pane holds the seat

the decree

Clickin in the title area should not deactivate that namespace

A decree landed mid-flight: the title box now catches its own clicks — pointer-events auto, the glass itself sworn into the dead-space exemption. A touch anywhere on the pane never rests the world; only the painting beyond it does. Proven with real hit-tested clicks: inside the glass the seat holds, outside it the lantern rests.

Act IV · Release

Shipped by decree

the decree

after that's done, i approve it. ship it

Issue #99 was filed with the full contract, the db pre-pushed verbatim on its own branch; FiremanDecko was dispatched to the summer hills — 107 turns, 13 suites green — and PR #100 squash-merged. The desktop mirror was rebuilt and marker-verified; the hall's new rollout carries the db itself — the name-link class, Fenrir's chronicles path, the say-so hall anchor — and answers healthz 200.

Act V · Coda

An unneeded key

the decree

gcloud token is in one password if it was u that needed it

The forge offered a key from the vault — unneeded: the cluster's own auth had held the whole way down. The realm db's copy into the garden itself now waits only for the redesign tree to settle, not for any door to open.
